name: confluence-sync
description: Git-like pull/push/status sync between local Markdown notes (Obsidian vault) and Confluence Cloud pages, split into four skills by risk: status (read-only), link, pull, push. One link command for pages and folders that accepts a pasted URL, title search, optimistic-locking conflict detection, Jira smart links, PlantUML and Mermaid diagrams, Confluence user mentions, note frontmatter mirroring and folder name sync. Also creates pages, folders and whole project trees from a spec.
